notes: CCTV 0.4.4 release candidate: Thai TV controls, Mi Box hold-OK menu, automatic H.264/H.265 detection, separate substream/mainstream technician tests, and vendor SDP compatibility fixes. H.265+ requires testing on your actual recorder and TV. Install over the existing retained-key app without uninstalling. Source and candidate notes: https://github.com/pnntrn/cctv-tv/releases/tag/v0.4.4-rc.2
